notes: Everything is in rounds/tester.py: checked_result (run for GET and again under the round lock for POST) refuses non-Open rounds and superseded builds, reads only the signed-in tester's result and, on POST, refuses a submitted one; the view writes the result itself, with no service layer. M4 also lets tester_result.html show the form for a submitted result, whose status line already reads 'Submitted'. ResultForm.clean requires a Fail observation (no database constraint) and RoundTextField(max_length=2000) limits it, so M5's message also says 2001. M3 leaves the tester round page's Open-only 'Record result' link in place (navigation, not a guard). M5 also widens the model field and its column in migration 0005 to 2001, together, because the varchar(2000) column would otherwise refuse the save (a 503) and a model-only change would fail the candidate's makemigrations --check test; pytest-django builds the test database from migrations on every run (no --reuse-db), so the migration edit is seen consistently.
